title: Leads
newHint: Filing a lead gives it to someone. It is waiting for them the moment you save.
empty: No lead filed yet. The first one starts from Add lead, above.
emptyManager: Marketing has not filed a lead yet.
emptyFilter: {count, plural, one {The one lead does not match these filters.} other {None of the # leads match these filters.}}
contactHint: A name and a number. Whoever takes the lead adds the rest when they call.
queryHint: In the customer’s words. This is the lead’s only note.
giveToHint: A rep, or yourself. They are told straight away.
reassignWarning: It moves to the person you choose, with the contacts and projects its current holder had on it.
reassignWaits: It waits for {name} to acknowledge it.
reassignBack: {name} filed it, so it counts as acknowledged at once.
reassignKeeps: It has already been acknowledged, and stays acknowledged with {name}.
